summary: Frontend-only verification of two just-applied ModuleTiles bug fixes on the Home screen at mobile viewport 390x844. Both fixes verified visually and programmatically: (1) A clear 16px vertical gap exists between the 3-tile row and the Cashflow card (marginBottom: SPACING.md is being applied). (2) Amount text is not clipped on any of the three tiles - compactAmount() converts values >= 1 lakh (e.g., Sales shows '₹1.23L' rather than a long form) and adjustsFontSizeToFit safety net is in place. Tile width was measured at 113px and the amount element rendered at 87px width with scrollWidth == clientWidth (no overflow) at 17px font. All three tiles have correct testIDs (module-tile-sales/purchases/expenses), tap navigation is functional: Sales -> /sales, Purchases -> /purchase, Expenses -> /expenses. Onboarding Skip button dismisses the intro flow and auth_token='mock_token_123' bypasses login as documented.
critical_code_review_comments: ModuleTiles.tsx compactAmount() correctly uses Indian numbering (1_00_000 = 1 lakh, 1_00_00_000 = 1 crore). Safe fallback returns raw when value is 0 or non-numeric.

Minor console warnings on web preview only (not app bugs): 'shadow* style props are deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' - these come from React Native Web internals, not project code. No action required.
Row style uses marginTop and marginBottom of SPACING.md which produces the intended 16px vertical gap - measured gap between tile row bottom and Cashflow card top is exactly 16px.
seed_data_creation: None. All data is mock-first via /app/frontend/src/services/api.ts fallbacks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home screen module tiles fully verified. Live API returns 7D-filter data (Sales ₹1.23L, Purchases ₹78,400, Expenses ₹45,200) which differs from the static MOCK_METRICS. The compactAmount helper triggered for Sales (>= 1 lakh, shown as ₹1.23L). Expenses ₹1,42,000 from MOCK_METRICS was not encountered in current live results but the same compaction logic would render it as ₹1.42L, confirmed by unit-scale of the helper.
rca_of_issue: N/A - fixes verified working. Bug 1 root cause was missing vertical margin on the tile row (fixed by adding marginBottom: SPACING.md). Bug 2 root cause was full-format amounts (e.g. ₹1,42,000) overflowing the narrow ~113px tile width; fixed with compactAmount() converting >= 1 lakh values to L/Cr shorthand plus adjustsFontSizeToFit / minimumFontScale=0.7 as fallback.
